GAP_AC_AMENDMENT: CREATE event file naming and data.id field.
Additional AC (from gap analysis): CREATE event JSON file must be named using the full 16-hex UUID (not truncated to 8-hex) — filename pattern: <16-hex-uuid>.json. The event data.id field must equal the 16-hex canonical form. Both assertions from T1 (8986-4be4) must be satisfied by this task, not just stdout dual-output.
